name: urumi-platform
description: Monorepo commands for the Urumi dashboard, gateway and MCP services.

scripts.install:apps: npm ci --prefix apps/woocommerce-mcp && npm ci --prefix apps/gateway && npm ci --prefix apps/dashboard && npm ci --prefix apps/utils-mcp && npm ci --prefix apps/everything-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/woocommerce-mcp && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/gateway && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/dashboard
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/woocommerce-mcp && npm test --prefix apps/gateway && npm test --prefix apps/utils-mcp
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/woocommerce-mcp && npm run build --prefix apps/gateway && npm run build --prefix apps/dashboard
